defs.def: on one occasion only; one time 仅一次；一次

ex.s: Once in a lecture, the professor tried repeating my name after me over and over in front of thirty classmates.
ex.t: 有一次在课上，教授当着三十名同学的面，一遍又一遍地跟着我重复我的名字。

ex.s: Success knocks at your door only once.
ex.t: 成功只敲你一次门。

ex.s: For the images that an artist creates, viewers will probably get far more enjoyment once they know the process used to create them.
ex.t: 对于艺术家创作的图像，观众一旦知道创作它们所用的过程，就可能获得远为更多的享受。

ex.s: Go shopping once a week.
ex.t: 每周购物一次。

ex.s: Once the registration form is received and processed, we will send a confirmation email within two business days.
ex.t: 一旦收到并处理注册表，我们将在两个工作日内发送确认邮件。

ex.s: Finish it all at once.
ex.t: 一次性全部完成。

ex.s: Klein writes, "America did not invent the steam engine, but once they grasped its passwords they put it to more uses than anyone else. "
ex.t: Klein写道："美国人没有发明蒸汽机，但一旦他们掌握了它的奥秘，它的用途就比任何人都多。"

ex.s: Once, a young woman, who was on her way to visit her family in South Africa, told me she was expecting her first baby.
ex.t: 一次，一位正要去南非探望家人的年轻女子告诉我，她怀上了第一个孩子。

ex.s: You have to make sure you don’t turn two pages at once and make sure you find the repeats in the music when you have to go back to the right spot.” Mr Titterton explained.
ex.t: 你必须确保一次不要翻两页，还要确保当你需要回到正确位置时能找到反复演奏的部分。"蒂特顿先生解释道。

ex.s: Once the drink is gone, the straw will take centuries to disappear.
ex.t: 一旦饮料喝完，吸管要花几个世纪才能降解消失。

ex.s: Once the book you've requested is delivered to the nearest branch, they will inform you by e-mail, so you can pick it up.
ex.t: 一旦你借的书送到最近的分馆，他们会通过电子邮件通知你，这样你就可以去取了。

ex.s: But once having met and liked them, we think how terrible it would have been, had we missed the chance.
ex.t: 但一旦我们遇到并喜欢上他们，我们就会想，如果错过了这个机会该有多糟糕。

ex.s: Holker once again opens its gardens in aid of the disadvantaged.
ex.t: 旅游业现在是道森城的主要产业——其目前人口为762人。

ex.s: He was just saying: “I’m king of this forest, and here is your reminder!” Once his message was delivered, he allowed me    70    (stay) and watch.
ex.t: 它只是在说："我是这片森林之王，这是提醒你！"一旦传达完信息，它允许我____70____（stay）留下观察。

ex.s: Many westerners   57   come to China cook much less than in their own countries once they realize how cheap   58   can be to eat out.
ex.t: 许多来中国的西方人____57____一旦意识到外出就餐可以有多便宜____58____，他们做的饭就比在自己国家时少得多。

ex.s: The obvious one is money; eating out once or twice a week may be   62  (afford) but doing this most days adds up.
ex.t: 明显的是钱；每周在外吃一两次或许___62___（afford），但大多数日子都这样，花费就累积起来了。

ex.s: shut the door and leave at once
ex.t: 关上门并立刻离开。

ex.s: The conversations and the questions will be spoken only once.
ex.t: 对话和问题只会播放一遍。

ex.s: The passages or conversation you will be asked several questions, the passages and the conversation will be read twice, but the questions will be spoken only once.
ex.t: 你将针对短文或对话回答若干问题，短文和对话将读两遍，但问题只读一遍。

ex.s: Each word can be used only once.
ex.t: 每个单词只能使用一次。

ex.s: Once marooned out on their islands, locals needed a currency to use among themselves, and so the shell currency was born.
ex.t: 一旦被困在自己的岛上，当地人就需要一种在他们之间使用的货币，于是贝壳货币诞生了。

ex.s: Each sentence can be used only once.
ex.t: 每个句子只能使用一次。

ex.s: The story once again tells us that one good turn deserves another.
ex.t: 这个故事再次告诉我们，一个好的转折值得另一个转折。

ex.s: Before getting into the car, I thought I had learned the instructor’s orders, so once I started the car, my mind goes blank.
ex.t: 在上车之前，我以为已经记住了教练的指令，可一旦发动车子，我的大脑就一片空白。

ex.s: Once they arrive, the tables are turned.
ex.t: 一旦它们到来，形势就会逆转。

ex.s: Once, while working overnight at a store, he let a homeless man   54   in his truck.
ex.t: 有一次，他在一家商店上夜班时，让一个无家可归的人____54____在他的卡车里。

ex.s: Once you are clear about your reason, tell your family or roommates about the change you want to make.
ex.t: 一旦你清楚了自己的理由，就告诉家人或室友你想做的改变。

ex.s: He knew that zxxk once he hit the hill, he’d be easy caught up and the wolf’s teeth would be tearing into his flesh.
ex.t: 他知道一旦上了坡，他就很容易被追上，狼的牙齿将会撕咬进他的肉里。

ex.s: You also have to wonder at the unique madness of a language in which a house can burn up as it burns down, in which you fill in a form by filling it out, and in which an alarm is only heard once it goes off!
ex.t: 您还必须惊讶于一种独特的疯狂语言，在这种语言中，房子可以在燃烧时燃烧，您可以通过填写表格来填写表格，并且只有在警报响起时才会听到警报！

ex.s: If this works, there may come a time when the number of monarch butterflies increases once again.
ex.t: 如果这奏效，或许有一天帝王蝶的数量会再次增长。

ex.s: This forms clouds from which rain falls down onto the mountain terraces once again.
ex.t: 这形成了云层，雨水再次落在山台上。

ex.s: Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Goldilocks.
ex.t: 从前，有一个叫金发姑娘的小女孩。

ex.s: More than once, I found myself wondering just how my students, who’d created these people, knew their subjects so well.
ex.t: 不止一次，我发现自己想知道，创造了这些角色的我的学生们，怎么会如此了解他们所写的人物。

ex.s: I learned that Freddy did several jobs after his   52    from high school and remained the same  53    person I met forty years before .Once, while working overnight at a store, he let a homeless man   54   in his truck .
ex.t: 我了解到弗雷迪高中____后做过几份工作，并且仍然是我四十年前认识的那个____53____的人。有一次，他在商店通宵工作时，让一个无家可归的人____54____在他的卡车里。

ex.s: I still remember   59   (visit) a friend who’d lived here for five years and I   60  (shock) when I learnt she hadn’t cooked once in all that time.
ex.t: 我还记得___59___（visit）一位在这里住了五年的朋友，当我得知她那段时间一次饭都没做过时，我___60___（shock）。

defs.def: at some time in the past 曾；曾经

ex.s: “That is only evidence that traditions once existed,” he said.
ex.t: "那只是传统曾经存在的证据，"他说。

ex.s: Around the world, kids are using imagination in ways that were once only found in science fiction.
ex.t: 在世界各地，孩子们正以曾经只在科幻小说中才能找到的方式运用想象力。

ex.s: “Age is just another bot- her attempting to convince you of the impossible in the world, but actually the world is filled with possibilities,” she once said.
ex.t: “年龄不过是另一个试图让你相信世界上不可能的事的bot-her，但实际上世界充满可能，”她曾说。

ex.s: Continued developments in communication technologies were once believed to make the printed page outdated.
ex.t: 通信技术的不断发展曾让人们以为印刷书页将会过时。

ex.s: I once took up a challenge to create a painting every day for a month and post the works online.
ex.t: 我曾接受过一个挑战：每天画一幅画，持续一个月，并把作品发到网上。

ex.s: The ability to judge others’ intentions is an indicator of possessing “theory of mind” which was once thought to be unique to humans.
ex.t: 判断他人意图的能力是拥有 " 思想理论 " 的一个指标，这种理论曾经被认为是人类特有的。

ex.s: By mile 17, I became out of breath and the once injured ankle hurt badly.
ex.t: 到第17英里时，我喘不过气来，曾经受伤的那只脚踝疼得厉害。

ex.s: He once told me he was surprised by what he saw on the table when he first visited my mother's parents in China.
ex.t: 他曾经告诉我，当他第一次去中国拜访我母亲的父母时，他对桌上看到的东西感到惊讶。

ex.s: Museums, once quiet places filled with history, are now full of digital excitement.
ex.t: 博物馆曾经是充满历史气息的安静场所，如今却处处洋溢着数字化的活力。

ex.s: Some scientists insist that once we discover the truth about the world, we are done.
ex.t: 一些科学家坚持认为，一旦我们发现了世界的真相，就大功告成了。

ex.s: Most page turners are piano students or up-and-coming concert pianists, although Ms Raspopova has once asked her husband to help her out on stage.
ex.t: 大多数翻谱员是钢琴学生或崭露头角的音乐会钢琴家，尽管拉斯波波娃女士曾经让她丈夫在台上帮忙。

ex.s: Some of your interests may not appear to be connected but, once you explore their depths, you discover that they are.
ex.t: 你的一些兴趣可能看起来互不相干，但一旦你探究它们的深度，就会发现它们是相关的。

ex.s: I once wrote a paper on the influence of fairy tales on Roald Dahl's writing and it gave me a new appreciation for his strange and delightful words.
ex.t: 我曾写过一篇关于童话对罗尔德·达尔写作影响的论文，它让我对他的奇异而妙趣横生的文字有了新的欣赏。

ex.s: Yet， now that I'm growing and the world I once knew as being so simple is becoming more complex， I find myself needing a way to escape． By opening a novel， I can leave behind my burdens and enter into a wonderful and mysterious world where I am now a new character． In these worlds I can become anyone． I don't have to write down what happened or what technique the author was using when he or she wrote this． I just read to relax．
ex.t: 然而，随着我渐渐长大，曾经以为如此简单的世界变得越来越复杂，我发现自己需要一种逃避的方式。打开一本小说，我就能抛开烦恼，进入一个奇妙而神秘的世界，在那里我成为一个新的角色。在这些世界里我可以成为任何人。我不必记下发生了什么，也不必分析作者写作时运用了什么技巧。我阅读只是为了放松。

ex.s: When I was 17， I read a magazine article about a museum called the McNay， once the home of a watercolorist named Marian McNay． She had requested the community to turn it into a museum upon her death． On a sunny Saturday， Sally and I drove over to the museum． She asked， "Do you have the address？ ""No， but I'll recognize it， there was a picture in the magazine．
ex.t: 我17岁时，读到一篇杂志文章，介绍一家叫麦克奈的博物馆，它曾是水彩画家玛丽安·麦克奈的故居。她曾要求社区在她去世后将其改为博物馆。一个阳光明媚的周六，萨莉和我开车去了博物馆。她问："你有地址吗？""没有，但我会认出来的，杂志上有照片。"

ex.s: Gray wolves once were seen here and there in the Yellowstone area and much of the continental United States, but they were gradually displaced by human development.
ex.t: 灰狼曾经出现在黄石地区和美国大陆许多地方，但由于人类活动的影响，它们逐渐被驱逐。

ex.s: Some plants pump out smelly chemicals to keep insects away.But others do double duty .They pump out perfumes designed to attract different insects who are natural enemies to the attackers.Once they arrive,the tables are turned .The attacker who was lunching now becomes lunch.
ex.t: 一些植物释放出难闻的化学物质来驱赶昆虫。但另一些植物则一石二鸟。它们释放出特意设计的香气，以吸引不同种类的昆虫，而这些昆虫正是攻击者的天敌。一旦它们到来，局势便发生逆转。原本在进食的攻击者现在变成了食物。

ex.s: William Hastie once suggested that history informs us of past mistakes                   we can learn without repeating them.
ex.t: 威廉·哈斯蒂曾经建议历史告诉我们过去的错误                   我们可以从中学习而不必重蹈覆辙。

defs.def: （用于否定句、疑问句和 if 后）曾，根本

ex.s: Once each family member has finished reading each magazine, you can use them for art and writing projects.
ex.t: 一旦每位家庭成员都读完了每本杂志，你就可以把它们用于艺术和写作项目。

ex.s: Even those who didn’t share that interest with me seemed more engaged once I showed a different side of myself.
ex.t: 即便是那些与我没有共同兴趣的学生，在我展现出不同的一面后，似乎也更投入了。

ex.s: Once in your account, select Electronic Articles Received.
ex.t: 进入你的账户后，选择“已收到的电子文章”。

ex.s: Today, they are once again a familiar sight, playing roles that are often just as important for the community as their original purpose.
ex.t: 如今，它们再次成为一道熟悉的风景，扮演着对社区来说往往与其最初用途同样重要的角色。

ex.s: I was performing this action of waiting until it later became  43  .Once that happened, I just kept   44  my studying further and further back in my day.
ex.t: 我一直在做这种等待的行为，直到后来它变得____43____。一旦如此，我就把学习一拖再拖，越推越后。

ex.s: •Once a pair has been determined to be suitable, the students will be contacted individually with a special permission number to register for the programme.
ex.t: •一旦一对学生被认定合适，就会分别联系他们，并提供一个特殊许可编号以注册该项目。

defs.def: all together; at the same time 一起；同时

ex.s: The historian Francis Cole argues that the West has entered a period where “only the present exists, a present characterised at once by the cruelty of the instant and by the boredom of an unending now”.
ex.t: 历史学家弗朗西斯·科尔认为，西方已进入一个"只有当下存在"的时期，这个当下同时以瞬间的残酷和无尽现在的无聊为特征。

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日，那天我们为收集物资付出的所有努力终于汇聚在一起。当我看到我们收集到的各种物资时，我突然意识到，那天我们要制作的每一个套装最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中。在过去的四个月里，我从未想象过项目完成后自己会有怎样的感受。在制作这些套装的过程中，我意识到自己已经忽略了它背后的真正意义——我只顾着把它当成又一个学校项目，而且是我想要拿高分的一个。当这些套装制作完成、准备送往海外时，那种温暖的感觉我将永远铭记。

defs.def: immediately; without delay 立即；马上
at the same time 同时

ex.s: Once we found the place, it was stressful getting lights and cameras set up in the limited time.
ex.t: 一旦我们找到那个地方，在有限的时间里安装灯光和摄像头 压力很大。
